summary: OpenCode Console (formerly Zen) is OpenCode's pay-as-you-go AI gateway for coding agents. Its official models page lists Big Pickle, a stealth model, as free for input, output and cached reads for a limited time; during the free period collected data may be used to improve the model. Model ID big-pickle, endpoint https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions, selectable in OpenCode as opencode/big-pickle.
claim_steps: Sign in to the OpenCode console, add your billing details and credits, and copy your API key.
Run /connect in the OpenCode TUI, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, and paste your API key.
